1) a robust, recurring climate oscillation is centered over the mid-latitude North Pacific Ocean, 2) the amplitude of this oscillation varies irregularly at inter-annual to inter-decadal timescales, 3) there is evidence that the oscillation reversed polarity in the mid-1940's and again in the mid 1970's, and 4) these reversals corresponded to dramatic shifts in the productivity of salmon in the Pacific Northwest
